name: murphy-kernel-extra
description: Extra vetted kernel-hardening sysctls (CIS / kernel-hardening guides). Absent keys SKIP, never false-fail.

rules.title: SUID programs don't dump core
rules.rationale: A core dump from a setuid process can spill privileged memory (keys, hashes) to a file a normal user can read.

rules.title: Hardlink protection on
rules.rationale: Without it, a user can hardlink to files they don't own and trick a privileged process into following them.

rules.title: Symlink protection on
rules.rationale: Blocks the classic /tmp symlink race a privileged writer can be tricked into following.

rules.title: FIFO protection in world-writable dirs
rules.rationale: Stops a spoofed FIFO in a sticky world-writable dir being used to hijack a privileged write.

rules.title: Regular-file protection in world-writable dirs
rules.rationale: Same idea as the FIFO guard, for regular files planted in sticky world-writable dirs.

rules.title: kexec kernel loading disabled
rules.rationale: kexec can boot an attacker-supplied kernel from a running system, bypassing Secure Boot and persistence defences. Setting it is one-way until reboot, so autopilot only applies it at --risk medium.

rules.title: Magic SysRq key restricted
rules.rationale: A wide-open SysRq lets someone at the console dump memory, kill processes, or thaw the box.
rules.fix: sysctl -w kernel.sysrq=0 (or 176 to keep only safe functions)

rules.title: Unprivileged user namespaces restricted
rules.rationale: Unprivileged user namespaces have been a recurring local-privesc surface (Debian-family key; SKIPs elsewhere). But disabling them breaks Flatpak, the Steam sandbox and Chrome's sandbox — so on a desktop this is advisory only, never auto-applied.
rules.fix: sysctl -w kernel.unprivileged_userns_clone=0  (skip if you run Flatpak/Steam/Chrome sandboxes)

rules.title: Kernel ftrace exposure restricted
rules.rationale: Context only — ftrace is powerful; note whether it's available on this kernel.
rules.fix: Consider disabling tracing on production hosts that don't need it.
